sloka: तथा तस्मिन् विलपति वसिष्ठो राज धर्मवित् ।सभाम् इक्ष्वाकु नाथस्य प्रविवेश महा यशाः ॥२-८१-९॥
transliteration: tathā tasmin vilapati vasiṣṭho rāja dharmavit ।sabhām ikṣvāku nāthasya praviveśa mahā yaśāḥ ॥2-81-9॥

translations.english: While Bharata was weeping, illustrious Vasistha, conversant with royal traditions, entered the assembly hall of the lord of the Iksvakus (king Dasaratha).
